name: Wei Jian Hao
bio:
Wei Jian Hao's precision and dedication to detail have made him a highly valued composite technician. Growing up near the Changi circuit, he was captivated by motorsport from a young age. He began his career with a local engineering firm specializing in carbon fiber manufacturing, gaining invaluable experience in composite materials. He joined Target Racing five years ago, quickly proving himself adept at repairing and modifying composite components for the race cars. 

Wei's calm demeanor and meticulous approach are crucial during high-pressure situations in the garage. He believes in continuous improvement, always seeking new techniques and materials to enhance the performance and durability of the car. His ambition is to one day lead the composite department, driving innovation in the team's use of advanced materials.

physical.description: Lean and wiry, Wei has a focused intensity in his dark eyes.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an exact point before starting any task.
Organizes his tools in strict order of size and function.
